content.title: Patriots' Day 2026 | Lexington, MA
content.text: Patriots' Day Weekend 2026 ScheduleThis schedule is subject to change.For additional programs and up-to-date information, please visit the Lex250 website.Between 5:45 PM and 6:15 PM there will be a flash mob and community sing-along!7:00 PM – Patriots' Day Awards Ceremony at Cary Memorial HallCommunity awards to recognize the recipients of the Lexington Minute Men Scholarship, White Tricorne Hat, Minuteman Cane and Pat Flynn Outstanding YouthPlease join us to light more bulbs on the VO250 Arch in recognition of community-wide volunteer service.9:00 PM – Paul Revere's RideHancock-Clarke House, 36 Hancock Street.
